entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 482 Bnss No. - 1345 of 2025

Applicant :- Mohd Zeeshan Alias Sanu
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- A.Z.Khan,Mohammad Asif

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.

The present application has been filed with the prayer to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant in Case Crime No. 65 of 2023, under Sections 420 I.P.C., 51/63 Copyright Act, 103/104 Trademark Act and 26/59 Food Safety Act, Police Station Chhatta, District Agra.

2. After arguing the matter at some length, Sri A.Z. Khan, learned counsel for the applicant, prays for withdrawal of the present application with liberty to the applicant to file regular bail application before the Court of competent jurisdiction.

Mohd Zeeshan Alias Sanu vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49132374/
1 3.

entities.text: Mohd Zeeshan Alias Sanu vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the above, this application is disposed of as withdrawn with liberty to the applicant to surrender before the concerned court and file regular bail application, which shall be decided in the light of decision rendered in Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another,
Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No (s) 5191 of 2021 decided on 07.10.2021.
4.
